We need to propose a 5-step retrosynthesis route for target molecule: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We have a template (id 29646) that seems to be deprotection of TBS? Actually retro_smarts: [C:2]-[OH]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si]... So it breaks O-Si bond, forming alcohol and TBS group removed. The apply_template gave three possible precursors: each with TBS group attached at different OH positions. The product is our target with TBS? Wait target has no Si. The precursors have Si attached. So step 1 retrosynthesis: remove TBS protecting group to give a precursor with TBS on one OH. Choose one that seems plausible: maybe the TBS is on the primary alcohol of side chain? The target has a primary alcohol (CO) side chain? Actually target: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O. There is a primary alcohol (CO) attached to the double bond side chain? The side chain: /C=C(CO)/C is a vinyl with CH2OH substituent. That OH is free. The other OH is the cyclic acetal? Actually there is an O attached to the ring (O[C@H]1...). That is a secondary alcohol. The TBS could protect either. The template gave three possibilities: each with TBS on different O. We need 5 steps total. Likely steps: 1) deprotect TBS (reverse of protection). 2) Still need to form the conjugated diene chain and carboxylic acid via Still-Gennari HWE (Z-alkene) maybe. 3) DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde? 4) Protect alcohols with TBS. 5) maybe start from simple building blocks like crotonic acid etc.

We need to construct route using available templates. We can search for Still-Gennari (Z-HWE) template. Search functional_groups_broken: ["carboxylic esters"] formed: ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters"] maybe. Already tried and got result (reaction_id 1914389) which seems to be a HWE type? That template includes phosphonate etc. Could be Still-Gennari. So step could be formation of the diene with carboxylic acid.

Also need to form the side chain double bond with CO substituent (allylic alcohol). Could be from aldehyde via HWE with phosphonate bearing CO? Actually the side chain is a vinyl alcohol (allylic alcohol). Could be from aldehyde reduction (DIBAL-H) of ester to aldehyde then HWE? Wait the side chain: /C=C(CO)/C is a trans-2-buten-1-ol? Actually structure: CH=CH-CH(OH)-CH3? No: /C=C(CO)/C means a double bond with a substituent CO (CH2OH) on the double bond carbon, and a methyl on the other carbon. So it's a 2-methyl-2-propen-1-ol? Actually CH2= C(CH2OH)CH3? That's 3-methyl-2-propen-1-ol? Anyway.

We can propose route: start from simple aldehyde (e.g., 3-methyl-2-butenal) then DIBAL-H to get allylic alcohol. Then protect with TBS. Then couple with cyclic diol via glycosylation? Actually the cyclic part is a tetrahydrofuran ring with two OH groups and a methyl substituent. Could be derived from a protected diol.

Given limited time, we can construct a plausible route using generic steps: 1) Protect primary alcohol with TBS. 2) Perform Still-Gennari HWE to install the carboxylic acid side chain onto the cyclic core. 3) DIBAL-H reduction of ester to aldehyde. 4) HWE to install the side chain double bond with CH2OH. 5) Deprotect TBS.

We need to provide JSON with reactions and template IDs. We have template IDs: 29646 for deprotection. Need IDs for Still-Gennari (maybe 1914389). Need ID for DIBAL-H reduction (search). Let's search for DIBAL-H reduction template.
